description: This file is a Node.js script for profiling memory usage of extension entrypoints in a project. It sets up environment, runs memory profiling for each extension, compares against a baseline, and outputs JSON reports. It contains logic for command-line argument parsing, process spawning, and report generation.

methods.name: printHelp
methods.description: Outputs usage instructions to the console.

methods.name: parsePositiveInt
methods.description: Parses a string as a positive integer, throws error if invalid.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments and returns options object.

methods.name: parseMaxRssMb
methods.description: Extracts maximum RSS memory in MB from stderr output.

methods.name: summarizeStderr
methods.description: Returns a summarized preview of stderr output.

methods.name: runCase
methods.description: Spawns a child process to run a profiling case, returns result object.

methods.name: buildImportBody
methods.description: Builds the body of a script to import files and measure memory.

methods.name: findExtensionEntries
methods.description: Finds built extension entrypoint files in the project directory.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function orchestrating profiling and reporting.
